user.title: House State
user.description: Create your house with the starter tree, or customize the initial configuration. Afterwards, use Settings → Devices & services → House State → Configure for structured settings. Configuration changes do not activate scenes.

warnings.title: Missing scene members
warnings.description:
These entities are missing from Home Assistant. Fix the scenes as needed. Continue to save:

{warnings}

error.invalid_config: Invalid tree, role, scene or setting. Check IDs, parents, occupancy roles and scene entities.

init.title: House State settings
init.description: Edit sections, then choose Save all changes. Nothing is applied until you save. Discard or close to cancel. Saving does not activate scenes.

states.title: States
states.description: Add or edit states and their position in the tree. IDs stay unchanged when editing names.

general.title: Initial state and roles
general.description: Choose — to disable a role. Arrival and night must resolve to an occupied state; departure and vacation to an unoccupied state.

presence.title: Arrival and departure
presence.description: Choose the entities that trigger arrival and departure. The grace period delays automatic departure.

legacy.title: Legacy helpers
legacy.description: Optional input_select helpers mirror the selected state and overlay. Clear a field to stop mirroring it.

night.title: Night schedule
night.description: Run the night role at a fixed local time or relative to sunrise/sunset.

night_details.title: Night schedule details
night_details.description: For sun events, a negative offset runs earlier and a positive offset runs later.

save.title: Save all changes
save.description:
Submit to validate and save the entire draft. If validation fails, go back and correct the relevant section. Scenes are not activated by saving.

{error}

warnings.title: Missing scene members
warnings.description:
These entities are missing from Home Assistant. Continue to save, or return to settings:

{warnings}

state_add.title: Add state
state_add.description: Use a unique ID with lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Leave the scene empty to inherit from an ancestor.

state_details.title: Edit state
state_details.description: Only direct children can be defaults. A state cannot be placed beneath itself or a descendant. Leave the scene empty to inherit.

state_edit.title: Choose state to edit
state_edit.description: Select the state by name and stable ID.

state_remove.title: Choose state to remove
state_remove.description: Removal is reviewed before changing the draft.

state_delete.title: Remove state
state_delete.description: Remove {name}? Its children move to its parent (or become roots). Defaults and roles pointing to it are cleared. Overlay conditions drop this state; removal is blocked if that would remove their only state condition. Select a new initial state if needed. The last state cannot be removed.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: Add manual overlays or activation rules. Higher priority wins when several rules match.

overlay_add.title: Add overlay
overlay_add.description: Choose a unique ID and activation rule. IDs none and auto are reserved. Empty allowed states means all states.

overlay_details.title: Edit overlay
overlay_details.description: Changing the rule type replaces its previous activation rule. Clear the scene to leave it unassigned.

overlay_edit.title: Choose overlay to edit
overlay_edit.description: Select an overlay by name and ID.

overlay_remove.title: Choose overlay to remove
overlay_remove.description: Removal is reviewed before changing the draft.

overlay_delete.title: Remove overlay
overlay_delete.description: Remove {name} and its activation rule from the draft?

overlay_rule.title: Activation rule
overlay_rule.description: Rule for {name}. Fixed dates use MM-DD (inclusive; may cross New Year). Easter uses day offsets. For weekday rules, choose month or anchor date; only the selected field is used. Negative occurrences count backwards. Returning discards this overlay edit.

data.anchor_kind: Count within month or relative to date

error.invalid_config: Invalid configuration. Check state references, role occupancy, scenes and settings. Return to the relevant section to correct it. Unsupported stored fields are preserved and must be corrected before saving.
error.invalid_state: Invalid or duplicate ID/name, parent, cycle or default child.
error.last_state: The last state cannot be removed. Add another state first.
error.state_gates_overlay: An overlay uses this as its only allowed state. Edit that overlay condition before removing the state.
error.invalid_overlay: Use a unique valid ID and nonempty name. none and auto are reserved IDs.
error.invalid_rule: Invalid activation rule. Check calendar, regular expression, dates and occurrence (not zero).
error.select_overlay: Select an overlay, or return to add one.

set.name: Set house state
set.description: Select a node (following default children) and/or an overlay atomically.

overlay.name: Overlay ID
overlay.description: Configured overlay ID, none to suppress until tomorrow, or auto to follow the configured rules.

force.name: Force scenes
force.description: Apply even if the scene pair is unchanged.

arrive.name: Arrive
arrive.description: Select the arrival role unless already occupied.

depart.name: Depart
depart.description: Select the departure or vacation role.

apply_scene.name: Apply scene now
apply_scene.description: Resolve the current scene and apply the overlay after it.

force.name: Force scenes
force.description: Defaults to true for manual resynchronization.

set_config.name: Configure house
set_config.description: Update options atomically. Trees, lists and objects replace the complete field. Apply scenes explicitly after editing.
